Olivia — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround.

Short answers up front:
- Redwood's default for new vendor setups is Net 30. Procurement and Finance will consider Net 45 or Net 60 on a case-by-case basis (usually tied to contract size and staffing).
- We do run an early-pay program via a third-party provider; typical vendor opt-ins use a tiered discount (0.5% for T+7, 1.0% for T+14, ~1.5% for T+30) but we'll need to confirm exact pricing for third-party enrollment.

Next steps I need from you to progress the PO activation:
1) Confirm preferred remit method (ACH vs physical check) and provide bank account stub or EFT template.
2) Complete the PO_Activation_Form_v2.xlsx fields on sheet "PO details" and re-upload to our vendor portal: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/fractal-activation
3) If you want Net 45/60 to be considered, please provide a short rationale (expected monthly run-rate or initial PO amount) so Marissa can present to Finance.

Looping in Marissa (Procurement Ops) and Kimberly (Finance) to handle PO routing and early-pay enrollment. Marissa — can you confirm the internal checklist and whether we can make an exception to Net 30 for an initial 90-day pilot?

Thanks — I can also schedule a quick 20-min call if that helps.
